newsitem.title: UK: Thomas Potts reviewing terms of Coalite bid.
newsitem.headline: Thomas Potts reviewing terms of Coalite bid.

text.p: Britain's Thomas Potts Plc said on Friday that it has been notified of information that might have an impact on the terms of its purchase of smokeless fuels manufacturer Coalite Products Ltd from Anglo United Plc.
"The directors are currently taking steps to review this information," said the company in a statement.
Thomas Potts said it would be adjourning a meeting of shareholders set for June 24 to vote on the acquisition as it is unlikely to be in a position to comment on the review before this date.
It announced in May that it was buying Coalite for 24.3 million stg and was planning a placing and open offer to finance the purchase.
